title: Inter SB celebrate 1 Liga title
description: FINALBlue Wings 2 - Inter SB 46-80 Inter SB dominated down low during the game scoring 44 of its points in the paint compared to Blue Wings 2's 22. They outrebounded Blue Wings 2 42-31 including 28 on the defensive glass. Inter SB brought some defensive toughness making 7 blocks. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international power forward Maros Golian (206-2007) who helped to win the game recording a double-double by scoring 28 points, 18 rebounds and 4 blocks (on 11-of-14 shooting from the field). point guard Bruno Randuska (191-2008) contributed with 12 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists for the winners. Four Inter SB players scored in double figures. Guard Andrej Nahlik (192-2006) answered with 10 points and 6 rebounds and forward Adam Galko (205-2004) added 6 points and 6 rebounds in the effort for Blue Wings 2.
